simple.meaning: to ascend , intransitively (be high ) or actively ( mount ); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָלָה (H5927) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
